title: Yeasty Bouncy Brazilian Fish Fillet Knead
description: A lazy Sunday Brazilian dish featuring a yeasty fish fillet with a bouncy twist, perfect for a high-protein meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, baking soda, and kosher salt.
Melt 1 tablespoon of unsalted butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sugar to the melted butter and stir until dissolved.
Pour the sugar mixture into the mixing bowl and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together active dry yeast and lukewarm water.
Add the yeast mixture to the mixing bowl and stir to combine.
Add the flounder fillets to the mixing bowl and toss to coat evenly.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Transfer the dough to a greased surface and shape into a ball.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Cut out 4 equal pieces of dough and place a flounder fillet on each piece.
Roll out the dough around each fillet to form a ball and press to seal.
Place the fish balls onto a greased baking sheet and brush with remaining 1 tablespoon of unsalted butter.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 12 minutes, or until golden brown.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve with a side of plain Greek yogurt.
